## A - Exam authority, Chapter Nine Alcohol and other drugs

This dossier supports first-time never-licensed applicants preparing for the regular passenger-car written knowledge test in New York. The issuing authority is the New York State Department of Motor Vehicles. Handbook facts in this section come from Chapter Nine of the Driver's Manual, covering alcohol effects, other drugs, blood-alcohol law, chemical tests, repeat-offender policy, zero tolerance, purchase and container law, the penalty table, interlocks and Leandra, reminders and avoidance. No exam-format values are asserted here; substance rules live as anchored facts in part C. Practice scoring follows only the accepted LearningLoop product policy.
